spine.active_goal: Bring the prototype's Meadow (renamed from Garden) into the live Flutter app: per-user, per-year randomized meadow generation, the year / day-by-day / year-so-far UI, viewing past years, and hover or select on a flower showing its planted date, while keeping the current aesthetic and making it smooth with up to 366 flowers on macOS and Android. Spec it with the interphase prototype pathway, get approval, then dispatch with mitosis.
spine.next_step: Ask the owner to decide the macOS Impeller glyph-corruption question before #244 merges (Flutter 3.47.5 engine race, flutter/flutter #184091, fixed for 3.48). Recommended first: a two-minute real-Mac look, the owner running the sweep plain build (~/.mitosis/field-notes/testkit/apps/sweep-347/plain.app, bundle dev.satanshumishra.fieldNotes.plain, separate data) with the Meadow page and full screen open. Then either merge #244 as is (Impeller on the Mac, upgrading to 3.48 when it is stable) or amend #244 to keep FLTEnableImpeller false on macOS until 3.48, after first checking that 3.47.5 Skia no longer crashes in the Meadow. Optionally run the Note10+ speed bench for 10.17 with sweep-bench.apk (id ...mbench, aapt check, adb install, am start, uninstall).
spine.last_session: 2026-09-30: lab sweep of #244+#245+#246 done. All fixes verified live in the VM lab and the full suite passes. Open: the Flutter 3.47.5 macOS Impeller glyph corruption (engine race) needs the owner's decision before the Mac switch merges.

open_risks.text: macOS builds render with Skia (no FLTEnableImpeller), and under Skia the Meadow crashes the app on io.flutter.raster in GrResourceCache purge or ref-count release, reached from Rasterizer::MakeSkiaGpuImage and frame flushes. On 2026-09-30 it crashed 5 times in the Parallels guest (full screen, month hover, about a minute idle on the page, empty Meadow after Delete all) and once on the host M4 Pro bench. The same builds with FLTEnableImpeller do not crash. Crash reports are in ~/.mitosis/field-notes/testkit/results/macos/sbx-2026-09-30/.

Under Impeller (Android by default, and macOS with FLTEnableImpeller) the Meadow's mountain frame (mountains, far forest, lake band) renders solid white at night. Noon renders correctly. The frame is composed with channel-packed masks, colour matrices, BlendMode.plus and dstIn in _composeMountains in lib/features/garden/render/meadow_layers.dart. Seen on the Note10+ and in the Mac guest on 2026-09-30.

Phone speed misses spec 16.22 (Note10+, bottom-bar layout, 366 flowers, two runs on 2026-09-30). Noon ran at 49.7 to 51.7 fps with raster p50 of 19.5 to 20.4 ms; midnight met 60 fps. Scene ready took 1.46 to 1.87 s against a 1 s target, and the longest frame was 331 to 522 ms against 100 ms. The Mac under Impeller missed the 100 ms limit only in study (114 to 132 ms).

integration_test/meadow_perf_bench_test.dart cannot measure full screen: _newestStage uses find.byType(MeadowStage), which skips the page stage once it is offstage under the full-screen route. All four full-screen cases time out. The fix is skipOffstage: false; it is applied only in the testkit worktree testkit/work/meadow-bench.
